about: The streak's reference cases, worked out by hand from the rule: a day counts when it has habits and every one is done; days that count in a row make the streak; it stays alive until the end of the day after the last day that counted. Today is 2026-10-27, a Tuesday. `checkins` are the days that count; `partial` days have a habit left undone.

cases.what: Three days in a row up to today
Two days in a row up to yesterday: still alive, and on the line until today counts
Yesterday was missed: the streak has ended, its best stays
A missed day between two runs: the streak is the run since
A longer run earlier is the best; the streak starts again at 1 then 2
A day with a habit left undone doesn't count, and breaks the run
A saved best higher than any run here is kept
